wire_scope: Each source-derived current terminal-to-tangent segment is transformed into rotating lever coordinates; only first 12 mm from ball centre, capsule diameter1.5. No old R60 wrap-slot ROI or u/60 angle assumption.
limits: All layer slabs use each command declared bead height, including bridge height, and actual local-Z orientation. XY swept disks use declared width with arc/buffer error; not PETG dimensions.

Positive clearance certifies only the stated ideal constant-height wire capsule or nominal sphere against the conservative emitted-bead slab envelope. Four discrete u values are not a continuous motion proof.
Negative lower clearance is possible contact under an over-covering slab projection, not automatically proven physical interference; bridge sag and wire bending are not modeled.

Circular opening measurements are supplemented by exact nominal SW5.5 hex polygon at30 degrees, nominal M3 rod/head cylinders and actual layer-slab overlap. No manufactured tolerance, torque, retention force or loaded-return proof.
Printed local split extremes do not prove flatness, tightening preload or bond strength. Candidate remains isolated.
